answers.core: I don't see how an addon could fix this, it seems pretty close to core to me considering it's the Editor's UI
answers.workaround: When running the game, this is easy to fix, you just need to get the parent's scaling, compute its inverse and scale by that inverted factor. The problem is being able to edit the global transform _while editing_.

title: Expose global transform in editor for 3D Nodes
